about_the_game:
Leadstorm Survivors is a fast, top‑down arena shooter built for short, high‑intensity runs. Kite smart, manage space, and shred swarms while every second pushes the pressure up. Between runs you bank points to permanently upgrade damage and fire rate, then jump back in to chase a bigger score and unlock all 5 arenas.

Why it hits:

  • Quick sessions, big dopamine. 1–5 minute runs that escalate fast.

  • Pure skill loop. Tight movement and precise aiming—no fluff, just you vs. the horde.

  • Permanent meta‑progression. Spend banked points on damage and fire‑rate upgrades to push further next time.

  • 5 hand‑crafted arenas. Different layouts that change how you kite and control space.

  • Clean, readable visuals. Bullets and enemies pop so decisions stay sharp at any pace.

  • Score‑chasing focus. Beat your best, climb your own curve, and unlock more maps as you improve.

If you love tight controls, fast feedback, and a “one more run” loop you can play on a break, Leadstorm Survivors was made for you.

name: Leadstorm Survivors

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual‑core CPU — e.g., Intel Core i3‑6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (e.g., Intel UHD 620 / GeForce GTX 750 / Radeon R7 360)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Built with Godot 4. Runs on Vulkan; falls back to OpenGL 3.3 on older GPUs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 / Intel Iris Xe or better
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p high‑FPS arena runs.

short_description: Fast top‑down arena shooter. Run short, high‑intensity sessions, shoot swarms, bank points between runs to upgrade damage and fire rate, and unlock 5 arenas. Perfect for quick score‑chasing that keeps getting tougher.
